t: Good news that a man wanted to run and tell everyone
a: أَتَانِي آتٍ مِنْ رَبِّي فَأَخْبَرَنِي ـ أَوْ قَالَ بَشَّرَنِي ـ أَنَّهُ مَنْ مَاتَ مِنْ أُمَّتِي لاَ يُشْرِكُ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ
m: Someone came to me from my Lord and gave me good news that whoever of my nation dies not associating anything with Allah will enter Paradise. I said: even if he commits adultery and steals? He said: even so.
